[[Speak with Headmaster Zhan (Warrior)]] | followed by = [[Talon's Duel]] | profession = Warrior | primary = y | secondary = n }} Find the first teacher in Canthan warrior training. ==Quest information== === Requirements === {{ Standard prerequisites | campaign = factions | profession = Warrior | primary = y | secondary = n }} ===Objectives=== * Search Sunqua Vale for Talon Silverwing. ===Early benefits=== *{{skill icon|Healing Signet}} *{{skill icon|Power Attack}} *{{skill icon|Sever Artery}} ===Reward=== * 100 [[Experience]] * 10 [[Gold]] ==Walkthrough== Talon is in the northwest of the vale. ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== ;Headmaster Zhan ''To become a great Warrior, or even a good one, you will need a vast amount of training. Each great journey, however, begins with just one step. To make your first step, seek out [[Talon Silverwing]] in [[Sunqua Vale]]. He is a great Tengu Warrior, and there is much he can teach you.'' {{ Offer dialog | accept = I will look for Talon Silverwing."'' | decline = Learn from a Tengu? I'd rather eat a pile of moa droppings."'' | ask = Do not forget: your first step is to search for [[Talon Silverwing]] in [[Sunqua Vale]]. }} ===Reward dialogue=== ;Talon Silverwing ''I assume Headmaster Zhan sent you. Well, let's have a look at you. Yes, the headmaster is a shrewd judge of potential as well as a great Warrior. During the wars known in these lands as the Tengu Wars, General Zhan bested me on the battlefield. He saw something in me, then, and spared my life. I am sworn now to protect and serve him. If he wishes you trained, then trained you will be.''
